# README.md

Source: https://github.com/caltech-ipac/irsa-tutorials/blob/main/README.md

IRSA Tutorials
==============

Notebooks developed to demonstrate IRSA use cases.

We do use MyST Markdown format for the notebooks, please visit [the upstream documentation](https://mystmd.org/guide/md-vs-ipynb) to learn more about the reasoning behind the choice. 
However, we add it here that you can easily have the same user experience in JupyterLab if these two dependencies are installed:
 - [jupytext library](https://pypi.org/project/jupytext/)
 - [jupyterlab-myst JupyterLab extension](https://pypi.org/project/jupyterlab-myst/)

---

# Caltech/IPAC—IRSA Python Notebook Tutorials

Source: https://github.com/caltech-ipac/irsa-tutorials/blob/main/index.md

# Caltech/IPAC—IRSA Python Notebook Tutorials


These Python Jupyter Notebook tutorials demonstrate access methods and techniques for working with data served by the [NASA/IPAC Infrared Science Archive (IRSA)](https://irsa.ipac.caltech.edu).
They cover topics like querying IRSA, working with catalogs in Parquet format, visualizing with Firefly, and general other techniques.



## About these notebooks

**Contact:** [the IRSA Helpdesk](https://irsa.ipac.caltech.edu/docs/help_desk.html) with questions or reporting problems.
